notes: Spec asserts: (1) Session appears in ready within 1s of agent launch and (2) PID bound within 1s. Both phases anchor UNPINNED to recording start (agent launch) with a 1000ms budget. Hermes writes no transcript file — one shared SQLite store at $HERMES_HOME/state.db — and its sessions row is INSERTed only ~2s after launch, on the first user message. The <1s birth is therefore carried by the proc-<PID> pre-session the process scanner mints from the CommandPattern match, exactly as in opencode's verified sibling cell; the store-backed session (id <YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>_<hex>) reconciles a couple of seconds later and supersedes it. Observations are provisional: model is the shipped config default (model.default: gpt-5.6-luna) confirmed against live sessions rows, and cost is priced by irrlicht's capacity table because Hermes reports estimated_cost_usd=0.0 under billing_mode='subscription_included'.
